title: Implement CSV patch batch codec
description: Implement the CSV codec for editable task batches after the shared batch types exist. Use the deterministic header order id,shortId,updatedAt,title,description,status,priority,estimate,lane,model,gitRepo,gitBranch,worktreeName,worktreeDir,assignee,dependencies,_clear. Require updatedAt and at least one identifier per row. Blank editable cells mean preserve, never clear. The _clear cell is a comma-separated list of clearable field names; reject unknown names, required fields, duplicate names, and any field that is both nonblank and listed for clearing. Encode dependencies as comma-separated task identifiers inside a correctly CSV-quoted cell; accept short IDs or UUIDs for later provider resolution. Use Go CSV handling for embedded commas, quotes, CRLF/LF, and multiline text; accept UTF-8 input with an optional BOM and emit deterministic UTF-8 without a BOM. Reject unknown/duplicate headers, missing required headers, ragged rows, duplicate task rows, malformed timestamps, and rows with no effective patch columns. Keep codec logic independent of CLI and file paths. Add table-driven round-trip, Windows line-ending, multiline, clear-semantics, and malformed-input tests, then run the package tests and go test ./....

comments.message: Milestone: implemented standalone internal/batchcsv codec with deterministic headers, BOM/UTF-8 handling, Go CSV parsing, strict headers/ragged rows/duplicates/timestamps, dependency lists, and _clear semantics. Adding table-driven tests next.
